capture: read every byte of both baseline files and the stable test; the row ownership helper was introduced after the stable release
stableDifference: the stable test pins OpenTUI 0.5.1 and main pins 0.5.6; the Rust renderer has no OpenTUI private method and owns its wheel state directly

behaviorProjection.nestedControlClaim: a nested file-view component returns true from the child handler, short-circuiting the parent file-header selection handler for the same MouseEvent
behaviorProjection.nestedControlIdentity: the captured file and row key replaces JavaScript WeakSet event identity while preserving one-gesture ownership
behaviorProjection.horizontalDirections: native ScrollLeft and ScrollRight plus Shift+ScrollUp and Shift+ScrollDown adjust the code-column offset when wrapping is disabled
behaviorProjection.verticalIsolation: a claimed horizontal gesture returns before vertical scroll handling
behaviorProjection.remainderReset: Workdeck resets its owned fractional vertical accumulator and acceleration immediately after horizontal routing
behaviorProjection.wrappedBehavior: with wrapping enabled Shift+Wheel remains an ordinary vertical review gesture

ratatuiAdaptation: Ratatui and crossterm expose events and scroll state directly, so the required missing-private-method failure becomes a compile-time owned-state guarantee instead of an OpenTUI compatibility reflection check
